_: Written by `ci-video narrate`. Records which line each mp3 is a read of, in which voice, on which engine, at what prosody — so a later edit to any of those can be detected instead of silently keeping the old recording. Commit this with the mp3s.

one-turn.text: Type a message. The reply lands in the log, and the same reply drives the mouth, the face and a body clip.

close.text: Spatial Companion, from Companion Intelligence. UnCloud your life.

first-run.text: It asks for a microphone once, on the first load. Skip it, and type instead.

quiet.text: Hide the panels and what is left is a face and one line to type into.

your-model.text: Point it at your own Ollama, or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint you run, or a proxy of your choosing.

in-the-tab.text: Or pick on-device, and one of the five providers runs the model inside the browser tab itself.

a-room.text: Put a room around it, and the camera steps back far enough to bring the whole body into frame.

already-there.text: No account, no sign-in, nothing in the log. There is just something on the other side of the screen, already awake.

pain-text-box.text: You have been talking to this thing for a year. You have never once looked at it, because there has never been anything to look at.

quit.text: Giving an assistant a face usually means a game engine, a character rig, and a bill that runs by the minute. Most people quit right about here.

title.text: This one is a browser tab.

what-stays-yours.text: Five ways to connect a model, a clip library of forty-seven, and a voice that needs no backend at all. None of it needs an account.
